method: Claude-written prompt -> design spec (BlenderSource/TownLife09/town09_shapes.py) -> Codex-style soft studio concept render of a throwaway blockout by BlenderSource/TownLife09/concept_render09.py. No AI image model was available in the cloud session; the prompts can be re-run with an image model.

images.name: 01_front.png
images.title: 正面
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Blender modeling reference for a xianxia (Chinese immortal-cultivation) open-world town, single game asset: 小鎮公告板 (NoticeBoard). Design: Two-post timber notice board with braced feet, plank panel, tiny tiled roof and six blank pinned paper notices (no lettering). Scale: Approx. 2.9 x 1.0 x 2.9 m; board face 2.2 x 1.2 m. Style: softly beveled stylized 3D game art matching the existing dondon town (dark cedar timber, blue-grey stone, charcoal tile roofs, restrained jade and ochre accents). View: straight front elevation, camera level, facing the -Y front, orthographic, entire object visible on a neutral warm paper background. No characters, no scenery, no text or lettering, no watermark.
